def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    wall=max(set(v for r in g for v in r),key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    # find panel column width: contiguous columns starting at 0 containing wall
    wc=0
    while wc<w and any(g[i][wc]==wall for i in range(h)): wc+=1
    out=[row[:wc] for row in g]
    # rows that are entirely wall within panel region = borders
    border=[i for i in range(h) if all(out[i][j]==wall for j in range(wc))]
    # collect shapes from right side
    seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(wc,w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                # flood fill
                stack=[(i,j)]; cells=set(); color=v
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=color: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.add((a,b))
                    stack+= [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                shapes.append((color,cells))
    # for each panel, find border-bounded block, hole pattern, match shape
    for a,b in zip(border,border[1:]):
        rows=[i for i in range(a+1,b)] if b>a+1 else []
        if not rows: continue
        holes={(i-a-1,j) for i in rows for j in range(1,wc-1) if g[i][j]!=wall}
        # pattern normalize: 1 where hole in bounding box
        def norm(cells):
            mi=min(i for i,j in cells); mj=min(j for i,j in cells)
            hh=max(i for i,j in cells)-mi+1; ww=max(j for i,j in cells)-mj+1
            return frozenset((i-mi,j-mj) for i,j in cells),hh,ww
        pn=norm(holes)
        for color,cells in shapes:
            sn=norm(cells)
            if pn[0]==sn[0]:
                for i in rows:
                    for j in range(1,wc-1):
                        if g[i][j]!=wall: out[i][j]=color
                break
    return out
